items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I haven't seen him in a few years, but I understand he's still gigging around New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, it wasn't with Frankie Newton, it was with those bands that you just mentioned. Louie Metcalf, I know that I was thinking of a trumpet player, Louie Metcalf.
He's still very much with us, right?
